name: Terrarium 60x30x30
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 60x30x30 cm. Volume: 54.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A 60x30 cm floor, 30 cm of height, 54 liters. Compared with the 60x30x25 model it is 5 cm taller, which leaves room for a thicker layer of substrate or a low branch. The format is horizontal and narrow, so it needs a shelf at least 30 cm deep.

Young kingsnakes and a young ball python use the 60 cm length and slip under the decor along the back. Hatchlings of Hermann's and Horsfield's tortoises need substrate they can dig into, so the extra height comes into its own here. For adult tortoises, skinks and bearded dragons this floor is too small, so regard it as a terrarium for the first period.

Wider models of the same length are the 60x40x30 and 60x45x30, and both give noticeably more floor. You choose the outer film from 34 patterns. We ship by courier anywhere in Serbia. A size to fit your shelf, for example 55 or 65 cm long, is built in 7 to 14 days.
